cases.boundary: A Unicode scope metadata field has UTF-8 input below 1 MiB, while its JSON escaped representation exceeds the existing 1 MiB receipt byte cap. The actual public writer returns False and leaves the prior receipt bytes and directory entries unchanged.
cases.limitation: An explicit API metadata-size test, not a claim that a real host or task uses such a scope name; no large process tree.

cases.boundary: Public check_active_roles refuses before polling, leaves SQLite STARTED and keeps the active role/receipt. No v2 owner authority is inferred from a schema label.
Actual local links to a retained file cannot reach polling/terminal/cleanup; both named paths preserve their bytes.

The exact receipt FD returns a faulted early EOF, or a real read is followed by a same-bytes new-inode path replacement. Both remain STARTED/HOLD before polling, and the displaced/retained objects are preserved.

Each case changes exactly one independent reference gate in a >64 KiB legacy schema1 receipt. Actual own SQLite terminal publication succeeds, but the foreign/malformed receipt and lock remain and the public consumer returns operational ERROR.
cases.limitation: 1200 ordinary-width identity records are simulated metadata. Unlike the earlier frozen baseline failures, these new cases explicitly reach the real terminal then cleanup comparison; they are not historical cleanup reds.

static_review.sources_reviewed: Complete three-module candidate snapshots retained; relevant full diff inspected at fc705a, source/control excerpts at 2b0d84.
conclusions: Only the no-strong-owner existing-receipt classification uses the dedicated legacy reader; existing RoleLaunch _current/_write and the generic attempt-effect 64 KiB reader remain unchanged.

The legacy reader enforces regular single-link files, unredirected parent identities, nonblocking no-follow opens, full observed-length/EOF and post-read path/FD identity checks. It is not a process-closure or atomic-unlink primitive.
Encoded payload admission precedes mkdir/temp-file/write/replace, preserving previous bytes on an oversized new payload.
Cleanup retains role/nonce/full seven-field reference matching, exact integer generation and a final captured-path identity check.
Missing-before-read legacy behavior is retained; disappearance or replacement after capture is not an empty receipt or successful cleanup.
Existing legacy orphan recovery and unconditional later _fs_unlock are not upgraded to strong tree proof by this slice.

document_review.timing: Entire 37-line document read after the test run; not included in the eight-file test pre/post manifest.
document_review.result: C3b section accurately limits its claim to legacy receipt storage compatibility, strict classification and matching receipt retention; it does not claim whole legacy process safety, atomic directory release or real 1200/4096-process tests.
